words.enExample: Take a pause between tasks to let your mind settle.
words.zhExample: 在两件事之间暂停一下，让思绪沉淀。
words.note: 源自古法语，原指“休止、停顿”。作名词/动词皆可：a brief pause / pause to think。近义：break / halt；反义：continue。

words.enExample: Learn to appreciate the small, quiet moments.
words.zhExample: 学会欣赏那些微小而安静的时刻。
words.note: ap-（朝向）+ preti（价值）→ 看清其价值。两义：①欣赏（事物之美）②感激（他人之恩）。名词 appreciation。近义：value / treasure。

words.enExample: This moment is the only one you truly have.
words.zhExample: 这一刻，才是你真正拥有的。
words.note: 来自拉丁 momentum（运动、片刻）。live in the moment = 活在当下。复数为 moments。近义：instant / minute。

words.enExample: An unhurried morning sets a calm tone for the day.
words.zhExample: 一个从容的早晨，定下整天的平和基调。
words.note: un-（不）+ hurried（匆忙的）→ 不慌张的。由 hurry 加否定前缀构成，描述从容节奏。近义：relaxed / leisurely；反义：rushed。

words.enExample: Let your mind wander without judging it.
words.zhExample: 让思绪随意飘荡，不去评判它。
words.note: 源自古英语，表“漫游、游荡”。wander 与 wonder（想知道）拼写易混。也可指走神：mind wanders。近义：roam / drift。

essay.title: The Quiet Gift of Time
essay.author: 佚名
paragraphs: ENWe treat time as something to defeat—to save, to hack, to squeeze into smaller boxes. But time is not an enemy to outrun. It is the medium in which a life actually happens, and the only resource that, once spent, is gone for good.

ENA slower day is not a wasted day. To pause and watch light move across a wall, to really taste a meal, to listen without planning your reply—these are not luxuries. They are the texture of being alive, and they cost nothing but attention.
ENSo give time the respect it deserves. Protect a few unhurried hours. Let your mind wander now and then. The urgent will always return; the quiet moment, once missed, will not.
translations: 中文我们把时间当成要击败的东西——要节省、要优化、要塞进更小的格子。但时间不是要甩开的敌人。它是一段生命真实发生的介质，也是唯一一种一旦花掉就永不回来的资源。
中文慢下来的一天，不是被浪费的一天。停下脚步看光在墙上移动，认真尝一口饭，不带盘算地去倾听——这些都不是奢侈。它们正是"活着"的质感，除了注意力，分文不取。
中文所以，请给予时间它应得的尊重。守护几个不被催促的小时。偶尔让思绪飘荡。紧急的事总会回来；而那安静的一刻，一旦错过，便不再来。

grammar.example: "It is the medium in which a life actually happens, and the only resource that, once spent, is gone for good."
"To pause and watch light move across a wall, to really taste a meal, to listen without planning your reply—these are not luxuries."
